title: Salary Structure
summary: Monthly pay by role and workdays, role expectations, and overtime notes for Zura Med Spa.

sections.title: Job Summary
paragraphs: Zura Med Spa is a wellness and medical spa focused on professional therapeutic massage and holistic body care. We are seeking disciplined and dedicated Massage Therapists who are passionate about health, wellness, and client care.

The ideal candidate must be willing to learn continuously, maintain professionalism, uphold nursing ethics, and provide excellent service to clients while representing the values of a medical spa environment.

sections.title: Work Schedule & Salary — Clinical Massage Therapist
paragraphs: Applicants may choose a preferred work schedule:

sections.title: Official Working Hours
paragraphs: Official working hours are 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
Sleepovers are allowed to handle late-night bookings. Extra compensation is paid per session handled overtime when the session start time is beyond 12:00 AM.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
list: Provide professional therapeutic massage services to clients.
Maintain a calm, safe, and relaxing environment for clients.
Uphold medical spa standards, hygiene, and infection control practices.
Receive and manage client calls, bookings, and inquiries professionally.
Attend to clients courteously and ensure they have a positive experience.
Manage client flow, appointments, and treatment schedules.
Assist in marketing and promoting Zura Med Spa services.
Maintain cleanliness of massage rooms, equipment, and spa environment.
Build good relationships with clients to encourage repeat visits.

sections.title: Professional Conduct
list: Maintain high professionalism at all times.
Uphold nursing ethics, confidentiality, and respect for clients.
Be courteous, respectful, and attentive to clients and colleagues.
Follow all spa rules, policies, and operational procedures.
Demonstrate seriousness, discipline, and responsibility in all duties.
Maintain proper grooming and professional appearance.

sections.title: Learning & Development
list: Be willing to learn new massage techniques and treatment methods.
Participate in training provided by the spa to improve skills.
Follow instructions from supervisors and senior therapists.

sections.title: Requirements
list: Interest or experience in massage therapy, spa services, or wellness care.
Good communication and customer service skills.
Ability to manage clients professionally.
Willingness to support marketing and client engagement.
Responsible, trustworthy, and hardworking.

remember: Therapist pay is ₦90,000 for six days a week or ₦70,000 for five days a week. Leaders earn ₦100,000 monthly (minimum six days). Correspondence and receptionist roles earn ₦70,000 monthly (minimum six days). Cleaners earn ₦60,000 monthly for six days. Late-night sessions starting after 12:00 AM attract extra overtime compensation per session.
